omens.name: Omen of Sanctification
omens.effect: Divine Orb on Rare → Sanctifies it. **Sanctified state is TERMINAL: each non-fractured mod's value is rerolled within tier range, then independently multiplied by a random factor in [0.8x, 1.2x] (0.01 increments → 41 discrete values per mod), rounded up on fractions. Fractured mods are FROZEN (immune to both phases). After commit, the item gains `sanctified: true` and cannot be modified by any crafting currency (Chaos/Exalt/Annul/Whittling/omens/Recombinator) — same lockout shape as Corruption but produced by Divine-Orb-with-Omen instead of Vaal Orb.** "Sanctification with Locks" = Hinekora's Lock retry-loop: preview the Sanctification outcome, abort via non-Sanctification Divine Orb if undesired, re-Lock and retry. Per-attempt success for +3 → +4 on a non-fractured target mod = 4/41 ≈ 9.76% (multiplier values 1.17, 1.18, 1.19, 1.20). Belton verbatim source: YouTube `Qs-Is4AgHXY` (2026-01).
